plausibility_notes: Explicit mixture match, locked-cupboard timeline, and shared-stock limitation form a fair and understandable narrowing step.
Material similarity is correctly distinguished from a unique torn-edge fit, leaving several viable alternatives.
This assumes the identified bottle supplied the poison; residue match makes that persuasive within official fictional forensics, though no chemical detail can prove exclusivity absolutely.
The statement that all Method examination excerpts are official findings is procedural game scaffolding, useful for separating evidence from possibly dishonest explanations.
Chip applied versus replaced a band is not necessarily inconsistent, but the precise timing of that replacement should remain clear.
Late-arrival admissions start to look designed to sort an opportunity set. They still require objective confirmation.
